notes: Compiler/Bake/benchmark code is unchanged from b97091ff; d73a77a adjusts only CI time bounds and differential progress reporting. Closing documentation and retained datasets do not alter tested source.
CI executes the PR test merge revision; artifact workflow metadata identifies the implementation head.
Bake excludes sanitizer configuration and rejects instrumented compiler defaults. Separate native regression CI still verifies sanitizers.
All six hosted reports contain 16 results and three per-process compile memory samples per result (288 successful probes).
Shared CI measurements are harness evidence, not isolated hardware baselines or speed guarantees.
Native frame span excludes deeper C helper stack usage; spill/reload counts are static emitted sites.
Retired managed string/Array constructs and future custom assembler/linker remain explicitly unsupported benchmark comparisons.
Native MSAN covers checked byte definedness and instrumented C accesses, not arbitrary assembly/FFI shadow propagation.
Hosted transcript artifacts expire after 30 days; the benchmark CSV/JSON files are retained in the repository.
